_note: HAND-AUTHORED STAND-INS, NOT RECORDED MODEL OUTPUT. Written so Stage 1's gates are runnable and demonstrable without an API key. Confidence values are what a careful reader would assign to these voice notes, chosen so both gates fire on real-looking data. Re-record with `npm run milestone-b -- --live` once GROQ_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, and replace this file before claiming these numbers came from a model.
